recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-20348 unless the work group separately revisits the later DocumentReference.context naming or sourcePatientInfo extension policy.
issue_request: FHIR-20348 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and requested removal of the DocumentReference.context backbone, promotion of its child elements to the resource root, and reordering as appropriate despite the breaking change.
initial_application: The change appears to have been applied by commit 0bf0b46a829ce94829ceef7e036dcb2043c74d18, the July 2020 DocumentReference block-vote commit, which removed the old DocumentReference.context backbone and nested children from the spreadsheet source and added promoted top-level replacements. Later refactoring moved the source into structuredefinition-DocumentReference.xml, and FHIR-29801 commit d41daf2563b8d8afcba4dfbd11b877607215cd74 renamed the promoted encounter element/search parameter to top-level DocumentReference.context.
additional_context: DocumentReference is an active current-build resource in source/fhir.ini. The authoritative StructureDefinition and search parameter bundle contain top-level DocumentReference.context, event, related, facilityType, practiceSetting, and period. The remaining DocumentReference.context.* lines in fhir.ini are version-conversion mappings, not current nested elements. The former sourcePatientInfo child was later removed by FHIR-32582 and retained as the documentreference-sourcepatient extension; FHIR-32582 is already represented on the combined branch. FHIR-54170 later clarified the top-level DocumentReference.context description without reintroducing a backbone.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The current context element is a later approved top-level encounter/context reference, not the removed FHIR-20348 backbone, and the other former children have either been promoted or superseded by later approved work.
